    Reducer.ofFailing()
    Returns a Reducer whose reduce(List, Object, BiFunction) method, for a given List of elements, returns the result of invoking its supplied failure handler.
    static <C, T> Reducer<C,T>
    Reducer.ofSimple()
    Returns a Reducer whose reduce(List, Object, BiFunction) method, for a given List of elements, returns the List's sole element if the List has exactly one element, and returns the result of invoking its supplied failure handler otherwise.
